Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
These questions arose during our last session:

1.

The situation was:

Vamp B striked with Zip Gun
Vamp A striked with Burst of Sunlight (Aggro)
Vamp B added Dragon Breath Rounds (Aggro)
Vamp A played Rotschreck.

Question: Who enters Torpor and who (if anyone) gets damage during this
combat?

2.

Player A and Player B are contesting cards.
Player A is ousted

Question: When does Player B control his card? Turn 'em up in his untap
or immediately?

(I think the former is right)

Michael Beer

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Michael Beer wrote:
> 1.

> Vamp B striked with Zip Gun
> Vamp A striked with Burst of Sunlight (Aggro)
> Vamp B added Dragon Breath Rounds (Aggro)
> Vamp A played Rotschreck.
>
> Question: Who enters Torpor and who (if anyone) gets damage during this
> combat?

Rotschreck ends the combat immediately (before any damage is dealt).
And Rotschreck sends vamp B to torpor.

> 2.
>
> Player A and Player B are contesting cards.
> Player A is ousted
>
> Question: When does Player B control his card? Turn 'em up in his untap
> or immediately?
>
> (I think the former is right)

You are correct.
